title: Arrested by the Germans on 7 December 1941
summary: The Germans knew where all Allied nationals lived and picked up Briggs at 9 a.m. on the day Japan attacked the United States.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Until the 7th of December,-- they didn't lose much time, 'cause everything was arranged, they knew where everyone was,
In other words, they, the Germans knew where all the Americans were
Yes, they knew where all the allies --
And, in the morning, we didn't even know that Japan had attacked the United States. We didn't know much. We found out when the Gerries came to pick us up.
They just came right up, on December 7th, they just turned up?
Yes. And at 9:00 o'clock in the morning.
9:00 o'clock in the morning. Yes, they just came and picked us up. Well, it was just one of those things.
We're still alive. I'm still alive.
